english.title: Assault SFO officer acting in exercise of relevant power
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), assaulted **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an SFO officer, who was acting in the exercise of a relevant power namely **(..SPECIFY POWER..) under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002
english.legislation: Contrary to section 453B(1) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assault
an SFO officer
who is acting in the exercise of a relevant power

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant assaulted **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an SFO officer, who was acting in the exercise of a relevant power namely **(..SPECIFY POWER..) under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 monthsNote: When section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force the reference to 6 months is to be read as a reference to 51 weeks.
